## What's New

- Deploy the Veeam Deployment Kit to Windows and Linux hosts from one bilingual workflow.
- Choose manual or automatic installation per host, with Windows remote deployment and complete Linux SSH privilege-elevation support.
- Create certificate-based Individual Computers protection groups and view per-host VBR rescan results.
- Includes readable error messages, Deployment Kit readiness checks, and versioned builds for Windows, Linux, and macOS.

Download the archive for your platform below and verify it with `checksums.txt`.
